description: SvForm with conditional fields in Svelte 5: visible and disabled are functions of the other values, hidden fields skip validation and drop out of the payload, a field can validate asynchronously, an async onSubmit shows a loading button, and showReset adds a Reset that restores the initial values.

faq.question: How do I show a field only when another has a value?
faq.answer: Give the field visible: (values) => values.contact === 'phone'. When it is hidden it is not validated and is left out of the submitted object.

faq.question: How does async validation work?
faq.answer: Give the field asyncValidate, a function returning a promise of a message or null, debounced by asyncDebounce; the field shows a pending state until it resolves and submit is blocked while any check is outstanding.

faq.question: What happens during an async submit?
faq.answer: The submit button shows its loading state and the form is disabled until the promise from onSubmit settles; a rejection surfaces as an error.
